definitions.explanation: Indicates a rate or frequency of once per second, or something that occurs each second.

examples.japanese: {毎秒|まいびょう}{三|さん}メートル{進|すす}む。
examples.english: It advances three meters per second.

examples.japanese: このセンサーは{毎秒|まいびょう}データを{送信|そうしん}する。
examples.english: This sensor transmits data every second.

examples.japanese: {光|ひかり}は{毎秒|まいびょう}{約|やく}{三十万|さんじゅうまん}キロメートルの{速|はや}さで{進|すす}む。
examples.english: Light travels at a speed of approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.

notes: Part of the {毎|まい}〜 series of time-frequency words: {毎日|まいにち} (every day), {毎週|まいしゅう} (every week), {毎月|まいつき} (every month), {毎年|まいとし} (every year), {毎分|まいふん} (every minute), {毎秒|まいびょう} (every second). Commonly used in scientific and technical contexts to express rates.
